If you would like me to check the status of your specific order, please share your email address and order number. Is there anything else I can help you with?

If you would like us to investigate your package, please share your order number and email address. Is there anything else I can help you with?

Carriers can sometimes prematurely mark packages as delivered before they arrive. We recommend waiting 24 hours, as packages often turn up shortly after.
Please also check with neighbors, building management, or around your delivery area in case it was left in a secure spot. If your package still hasn't arrived after 24 hours, share your order number and email address with me and our team will be glad to investigate it for you.
